description: Smart LLM-enabled investment tracker that consolidates and monitors market performance across your different brokerages

summary.one_liner: Investbrain is a self-hosted, open-source investment tracker built on Laravel that consolidates portfolios from multiple brokerages and monitors their market performance, with optional AI chat over your holdings.
summary.what_it_does: Investbrain is a Laravel PHP web application for tracking investments and portfolios. It pulls market data through an extensible provider interface, with built-in named providers such as Yahoo Finance, Twelve Data, Finnhub, Alpaca, and Alpha Vantage, and supports a fallback chain so the next provider is tried if one fails. It offers an AI "chat with your holdings" assistant grounded on your own investments, using OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, or Ollama and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. Portfolios and transactions can be imported and exported, with imports upserting records by ID. A set of artisan command-line utilities refreshes market, dividend, split, and currency data, captures daily change snapshots, and recalculates cost basis. The README also mentions i18n, accessibility, and dark mode support.
use_cases: Track holdings across multiple brokerage accounts in one place
Monitor daily portfolio performance and charts
Ask an AI assistant questions about my own investments
Back up or move portfolio and transaction data via import/export
Pull stock prices and dividend data from several market data APIs
how_to_run: Install Docker Engine on your machine
Download the docker-compose.yml file (the README's curl command is missing its URL)
Adjust the environment properties in the compose file or a .env file
Run `docker compose up` and open Investbrain in your browser
To update: `docker compose stop`, then `docker image pull investbrainapp/investbrain:latest`, then `docker compose up`
notable: Market data fallback: list multiple providers in MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER and it tries each in turn
Chat with your holdings via OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, Ollama, and other OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Extensible MarketDataInterface lets developers add custom data providers
Command-line utilities for refreshing data, syncing holdings, and recalculating cost basis
caveats: Yahoo data can be blocked by firewalls or ad blockers; the README says Pi-hole blocks fc.yahoo.com
Some commands are resource intensive (sync:daily-change) or can make irreversible changes, so backups are advised
License is CC-BY-NC 4.0 per the README, which is non-commercial and may conflict with the GitHub metadata's NOASSERTION
